2607.05123.title: ASSEMCAD: Production-Ready CAD Assembly Generation from Natural Language
2607.05123.paper_summary: Recent advances in large language models and programmatic CAD have significantly improved Text-to-CAD generation for individual parts. However, production-ready mechanical assembly generation remains largely unsolved. Unlike single-part modeling, assemblies require coordinated reasoning over multiple components, functional interfaces, assembly relations, engineering principles, and physical consistency. Consequently, directly generating executable CAD code is insufficient for constructing mechanically valid and reusable assemblies. We present AssemCAD, an axiom-grounded framework for production-ready CAD assembly generation from natural language. Instead of representing an assembly as monolithic CAD code, AssemCAD first constructs an axiomatic Assembly Specification consisting of typed parts, geometry-backed ports, executable mates, and engineering axioms. Each assembly relation is explicitly grounded in one or more engineering principles, making the resulting specification interpretable, reusable, and verifiable. To realize this specification, AssemCAD introduces a port- and mate-based CAD assembly library that executes symbolic assembly relations through deterministic mate transformations and validates declared interfaces using concrete B-Rep geometric evidence. Built on this representation and library, AssemCAD further supports on-demand synthesis of reusable parametric component factories for both standard and open-world geometries. Experiments on AssemBench show that AssemCAD substantially improves assembly preservation and physical validity over code-centric CAD generation baselines, while generalizing across different foundation-model backbones. By combining axiom-grounded assembly reasoning with deterministic geometric execution, AssemCAD extends Text-to-CAD from isolated part generation toward production-ready mechanical assembly design.
2607.05123.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型和程式化CAD方面的進展顯著改善了單個零件的文本到CAD生成。然而，生產就緒的機械組裝生成仍然在很大程度上未得到解決。與單一零件建模不同，組裝需要對多個組件、功能介面、組裝關係、工程原則和物理一致性進行協調推理。因此，直接生成可執行的CAD代碼不足以構建機械上有效且可重用的組裝。我們提出了AssemCAD，一個基於公理的框架，用於從自然語言生成生產就緒的CAD組裝。AssemCAD並不是將組裝表示為單一的CAD代碼，而是首先構建一個公理化的組裝規範，包括類型化的零件、基於幾何的端口、可執行的配合和工程公理。每個組裝關係明確基於一個或多個工程原則，使得生成的規範可解釋、可重用且可驗證。為了實現這一規範，AssemCAD引入了一個基於端口和配合的CAD組裝庫，通過確定性配合變換執行符號組裝關係，並使用具體的B-Rep幾何證據驗證聲明的介面。基於這一表示和庫，AssemCAD進一步支持按需合成可重用的參數化組件工廠，適用於標準和開放世界幾何。AssemBench上的實驗顯示，AssemCAD在組裝保留和物理有效性方面顯著改善了以代碼為中心的CAD生成基準，同時在不同的基礎模型架構中進行了泛化。通過將基於公理的組裝推理與確定性幾何執行相結合，AssemCAD將文本到CAD的範疇從孤立的零件生成擴展到生產就緒的機械組裝設計。
